description:
Young Claire lives with her mother and her twin sister in a humble country home. Feeling mature for her age, Claire is tired of being different from everyone she’s ever met. However, when her father suddenly appears, she realizes that she wasn’t the only “strange” one in the family. As she slowly learns about her family’s past, she understands more about herself and her destiny.

*Source: Pocket Comics*

----

Claire has always known she was different. Constantly on the run and exhibiting unique abilities, she’s always questioned her origins and past. Fortunately, a tidal wave of answers in the shape of Duke Arshel has just hit her small family. Introducing himself as Claire’s father, the duke exposes several more revelations that begin to illuminate the previously shadowed past of the young girl.

*Source: Tapas*
